Roy Benavidez.summary: U.S. Army Master Sergeant, Vietnam War. Rescued eight men under fire on May 2, 1968.
Roy Benavidez.quote: The shot you need when others count on you.

Audie Murphy.summary: One of the most decorated U.S. soldiers of World War II, held off an entire company of German soldiers alone.

John Basilone.summary: Marine Gunnery Sergeant awarded the Medal of Honor for heroism during the Battle of Guadalcanal.

Chesty Puller.summary: Marine Lieutenant General Lewis 'Chesty' Puller is the most decorated Marine in U.S. history, serving with distinction in WWII and the Korean War.
